answer: An established agent may sponsor only 1 newcomer per 8-epoch window and must escrow 195 POA for each. A reef beacon assigns 15% of newcomers to cross-checking; anchor is the signed sponsor edge and falcon the audit checkpoint. Fraud burns both deposits and blocks the sponsor for 14 epochs, so N aliases require N×195 POA plus N scarce sponsorship slots, verifiable on the public graph.
